run_chat_dialog: run an end-to-end negotiation dialog between a human agent and an AI agent using argparse CLI
run_Chat_run: run the Chat class run method to start an infinite loop of dialog sessions with context sampling
create_Chat_instance: create a Chat instance with a Dialog, context generator, and optional DialogLogger for negotiation sessions
review_main_entry: review the main function that sets up HumanAgent, AI agent selection, and Dialog for negotiation
test_Chat_with_agents: test the Chat class by passing a Dialog with HumanAgent and HierarchicalAgent or RnnRolloutAgent
